primary.scope:
Capture all historical inputs using the feasible head-only core at nominal 12 MHz.

This is standalone streaming zero-delay RTL. No UART, delay/glitch, activity
total, physical power or energy result is produced.

clock.note: 1 ps rounding; archived implementation target remains unchanged

workload.input_source: all saved x_test_bits.npy rows in unchanged order
workload.drain: hold final image; three falling edges after final output check
workload.baseline: historical exploratory model; no retraining or selection

events.scope: Ledger boundaries for future analysis; not a validated switching window

waveform.scope: Recording observability only; no activity counts or window validation

limits: Historical exploratory model and previously inspected digits inputs
Standalone streaming head-only core, not UART workload
Nominal12MHz rounded to83,334ps simulated period; no implementation-constraint change
Raw capture includes reset/fill/drain; no activity-analysis window approval
No switching totals, mapped-delay glitches, power, energy or novelty claim
